source.title: 诊断学（第10版）
source.section: 第五篇 辅助检查 第一章 心电图 第七节

textbook_summary: High calcium shortens ST/QT; low calcium prolongs ST/QT and may narrow upright T.
limitations: Fixed illustrations, not digitized patient ECG or calcium concentration mapping
No arrhythmia inference or perfusion change
Other low-calcium T morphologies and absent-ST high-calcium variants remain open
